# sigma_folder (Resource)

A folder in Sigma's file system. Folders can be nested inside workspaces or other folders via `parent_id`. Deleting a folder archives it — content is preserved and can be restored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a top-level folder in the org root.
resource "sigma_folder" "reports" {
  name        = "Reports"
  description = "Shared reporting folder"
}

# Create a nested folder inside an existing workspace or folder.
resource "sigma_folder" "team_reports" {
  name      = "Team Reports"
  parent_id = "<workspace-or-folder-id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (String)
- `parent_id` (String) ID of the parent folder or workspace. Omit to create in the org root.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_archived` (Boolean)
- `path` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_folder.example '<folder_id>'
```
